A key which opens an entrance to the second of Stromwell's Rifts. Now aware of your intrusions, the devious inspector has prepared his pocket dimension for your arrival...
A key which opens an entrance to the third of Stromwell's Rifts. Retreating further into the darkness of nightmatter, he unlocks the path to an unknown end.
A key which opens an entrance to a Sprite World. As an entirely different plane of existence, it is meant to safeguard the sprites that watch over the realm's ecosystems.
A key which opens a passage to the Manor of the Immortals. Lord Ruthven's gothic mansion neighbor's Oryx's own castle in the dark, distant sea.

A key which opens an entrance to Deadwater Docks. In contrast to his rival, Dreadstump, Jon Bilgewater's crew made their hideout deeper inland at the belly of a peninsula. It still reeks of cheap rum, though.

A key which opens a passage to the Lost Halls. Forgotten for centuries, those long identical halls are said to house evil itself. All that is truly known is that hope, reason and purpose are no more within those walls.
A key which opens an entrance to a Snake Pit. Once a temple, these chambers are now overrun by the serpents of Medusa's sister.

A key which opens a portal to the Haunted Cemetery. Some of the oldest and most legendary heroes in history were buried along this sequence of graves, their spirits protected by masters of the afterlife.
A key which opens an entrance to the Mountain Temple. Steep, distant cliffs conceal a clan of demon-worshipping monks.

A key which opens an entrance to The Shatters. The gloomy and abandoned ruins, enveloped by twilight, are now the shelter of the shadows. Once a legendary kingdom, its walls are broken, its dwellers are forgotten. No living souls have entered these grounds, no noble creatures have stepped into it. The immense kingdom has fallen, its sentinels have turned to dust. No one remembers its name, and no one will.
A key which opens the way to the Ancient Ruins. What was once an ancient shrine linked to the world of spirits is now a desolate ruin.
A key which opens an entrance to the Cursed Library. Once a great hub of knowledge, these forsaken archives now hold something far more sinister.

A key which opens an entrance to the Sulfurous Wetlands, a desolate village once bustling with human activity. Corruption has ravaged the land, and culled its denizens. The buildings and roadways many once called home are now dominated by vicious flora and fauna and a seemingly endless corrosive swamp.
A key which opens an entrance to the Fungal Cavern. This forgotten mine has been taken over by mushroom tribes over the years.
A key which opens an entrance to an Undead Lair. Septavius, once one of the most prominent combatants to ever live, now takes refuge in these abandoned catacombs.
A key which opens an entrance to an Ocean Trench. Many sailors met their ends in these waters from the deceptive songs of mermaids.
A key which opens the portal to the Lair of Draconis. Oryx has personally bred these captive dragons to wield immensely powerful elemental capabilities.
A key which opens a gate to the Moonlight Village. Accept the welcoming call of the spirits and join in on the festival's dance!
A key which opens a passage to the Time Chamber. Reworked dungeons are a replacement not just an improvment, Craig strives to maintain his olds friends sanity so they don't get lost to time..

The gas tank attached to this weapon has been redesigned using the renovated factory on Katalund. It can now store even more potent toxic gas.
Steeped in the acid rainwater of Forax, the chemical coating has transformed this already mighty blade into a heavy-hitting weapon of war.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

Modified with even more rainwater this weapon has become too heavy to wield for most. Its strikes are now reminiscent of the earthquakes that have been plaguing Forax ever since Neo Energy was infused into the planet.
Though rather unremarkable as far as alien weapons go, Malogian clans swear by this weapon as a good luck charm. Some things never change.
While Malogia has evolved technologically, there are still many who refuse to give up on their prized lucky blades preferring to repair and improve them instead.
The frigid landscape of Untaris is chilled by the moonlight reflected from a planet of astral frost.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient

This dual-bladed version reflects additional moonlight when spinning the blade creating a stronger beam. This was the original theory behind this weapon. In practice simply throwing it to directly cut targets is more effective.
A stunning bow forged in the heat of a massive star many lightyears beyond the realm.
Reinforced with katalonian laser technology this bow is now brighter than the star that birthed it. Any who lay eyes upon it run the risk of going blind.
The abnormal alignment of Malogia's moons block direct light from its sun during most of its revolution. The brief periods of visibility are ferociously hot.\n\nSprite Credits: Artauris
Malogians turned their sun into the symbol of their rebellion against the Vylar Empire. This bow forged to honor the sun was one of the many weapons used in the battle.

An easy way to create an acid blade is to pour acid in a hunger's hollow fang. Once frozen its edge will be both sharp and corrosive. This technique is even more effective when using a starvation's fang.

Katalund once had its own intelligent organic life, they ravaged the planet with constant battles over territory. It is unknown how their civilization came to an end but it can be certain they once used wands like this one to take over the world.
A wand held together by an ice crystal extracted from the depths of Untaris. Each shot possesses the concentrated force of a blizzard.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
Every bit of Untaris has been taken over by Tarul, even the frozen crystal that enamors this very wand. All it's good for now is expanding the cosmic parasite's vision of the universe.
The acid water found on the shores of Forax is quite dangerous but with the right chemical reactions it can be turned into a powerful tonic.
A battery salvaged from one of Katalund's inhabitants. It still has some juice in it.
The inhabitants of Malogia used to eat these with the horns until they developed a way to remove them without destroying the nutrional value.

The power of the stars in the palm of your hand. Its power output is quite unstable.

Recovered from the wreckage of a Viking ship, this large buckler can strike unlike any other shield. It can sustain the force of its strike in the air itself, uniquely constructed to mimic the Viking tale of Thielief the Steadfast catching a relic suspended in the air during a raid of saintly territory.

Painstakingly forged through an immeasurable amount of iron rings linked together, this armor allows its wearer to remain more agile and flexible than traditional armors. The speed rivals that of the legendary Viking Diggsun, whose tide-turning charge on the edge of the battlefield won a great war.
A ceremonial horn gifted to the Vikings from their ancient gods. Blowing it is said to temporarily bestow to the owner the power of Odin, known by some northern clans as Zimmer.

An enchanted mace that summons allies.
A mace which materializes mystical creatures to support in combat.
A gleaming mace capable of powerful summons for those who are experienced in the magical arts.
A decorated mace of high status, signifying achievement in advanced summoning styles.
An imposing mace built specifically for battle application, staggering foes with its intimidating design.
A majestically grand mace used in royal courts as a show of formidable might.
An opulent mace built of dense nightmatter and enchanted to harness the power of the infinite void for unspeakably powerful summoning.
A supremely dominant mace of faultless design, capable of manifesting entire armies in the astral wars.
A consummate mace present since the formative era of the universe, believed to have created life itself in the hand of a long forgotten deity.
Limon's power of nature restoration are infused into this mace for her children to wield, traversing the realm and planting seeds of new life in the wake of wanton destruction.

This formerly ordinary mace was twisted by Arachna's son after plucking it from a hapless victim. Though he has no reason to use it himself, some believe the Son of Arancha keeps it as reminder to his kin to not cross him as he did his mother.
The guiding power of the realm's pollinating drones. Even when stolen from their proper queen, it can still briefly influence their minds to service.

Easter celebrations call for eggs, but Oryx's strict regulations on anything that might be a chicken makes eggs risky. This mace mimics the functions of an egg to summon pre-grown rabbits, with exactly the personality you'd expect from an animal raised by a weapon.

Labyrinth guarding calls for beasts, but Oryx's strict regulations on anything that might be a cow makes bulls risky. This mace mimics the functions of a maze to summon pre-grown minotaurs, with exactly the personality you'd expect from a monster raised by a weapon.
A mace capable of channeling the skills of one of Bilgewater's most prolific gunslingers.
A highly versatile tool modified from what was once just a vial holder. It can extend and retract, tighten for wrench functions, and shoot energy blasts. All the usual tools of science!
Development of this compact M.E.R.V. took an explosive turn.
Not to be confused with a more traditional lab coat, this robe is steeped in chemicals to protect from radiation. This same substance surrounds the labratory's protective A.E.G.I.S. system.
This feat of technology enables approved users to control all primary functions of the lab facility and access otherwise encrypted data.
A wicked mace constructed by Dr. Terrible to impose the Mad God's will. It stands as one of Oryx's greatest attempts at merging magic and technology.
Small particles of energy visibly buzz around inside the glistening crystals of this mace.
A self-obsessed summoner's failed attempt at creating infinite armies.
The bitter cold of the realm's most frigid point is encased in this mace's handle, channeling the temperature to summon a creature hardy enough to endure such conditions.

A soothing crescent-shaped instrument known to relax one's body and mind when played, lowering their guard and making oneself drowsy. Only its player can hear the quiet melodies, sure to have them counting sheep in no time.

This cryptic blade has been forged from belligerent energies of the great beyond. Wielding it twists mortal comprehension of right and wrong.
A mystifying sigil from an otherwordly domain. The power sealed within causes it to faintly pull at its surroundings, attempting to draw them into the void.

The individual plates of this armor shift constantly in and out of realms under the Void's influence. The few mortals that have found, let alone are able to wear this cursed armor become entranced in protective and destructive forces.
Though lacking physical form, this trinket grants a sense of sight that allows beings from the realm of shadow to peer into the worlds bathed in light.
The eldest of Daeva warriors crafted this sacred weapon to smite all that dare oppose the forces of the light.
A glorious artifact, bestowed upon mortals from Daeva warriors. Emulating their altruistic goals, this prism can forge countless fighters from the pure lights of the heavens.
These garments have been meticulously crafted over the millennia to serve the Daeva, helping them ward off and fight against the ever burning forces of darkness.
A mere flame from the legendary forgefire used by Daeva master crafters, this trinket grants awe-inspiring powers to those deemed worthy.
A vile weapon ablaze with the Void's malevolent intent.
A celestial bow that strikes as true as its wielder's heart is.
A staff that can only be wielded by those embodying both justice and power.
Brought forth by an intruder from the Void, this wand has a mind of its own.
A heavy blade wielded by the monstrous warriors of the Void.
An instrument of justice, enchanted in the clouds.
Crafted from the hide of an unspeakable horror.
Said to give power over the forces of the Void, at a price higher than most are willing to pay.
The shining armor worn by the winged Daeva warriors.
A burning shard hailing from the Void itself; the concentrated torment of lost souls.
A small yet potent flame brought down from the heavens. It burns bright with the power of life.
A healthy, tree-shaped snack. Guaranteed to contain zero tree!
Cholesterol won't be an issue. Promise!
Full of potassium and only a little radioactive!
It is orange, round and full of nutrients.
Refreshing, but may give your pet brain freeze.
With the caloric power of a thousand suns!
A twisted concoction, created after imbuing the golden nectar of the gods with the power of the Void.
The very lifeblood of holiness.
Straight from the heavens, this drink may give your pet abilities in poetry.
Do not be alarmed by its toxic green color - Calbrik's grandma actually whipped it together from common herbs.
Definitely not poisonous. Actually mimics a poisonous mushroom. Trust it!
Yeah, it does taste a bit weird. Worth it, though!
A solution of the Void's concentrated power, this potent elixir may kill you... or make you stronger.
With its fresh, herbal taste, this sparkling potion invokes a feeling of euphoria and overwhelming confidence.
Grown in the clouds and fermented to make Ambrosia.

A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.
A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.
Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.
A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.
Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.
This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.
Exceedingly large and challenging to handle, this titanic blade embodies the stoic might of its true owner.
An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.

Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.
The lavish robes of the kingdom's royalty, outfitted with pauldrons on both shoulders for a more distinguished appearance. A sinister presence remains channeled through the draping fabric.
Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.
Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.
A small dose of a bitter-tasting remedy from the Shattered Kingdom. In a strange sense, it feels older than the kingdom itself.
Part of a sacramental rite, the memory of which has faded with those who observed its divine grace.

A mosquito's fare.
Just a sample of an exquisite cocktail. If you're a vampire.
But really, it's mostly made of fruits. Mostly.
The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!
The Lycanthrope, with beastly mane!
Beware the Lycanthrope, my son!
And shun the frumious Man-Wolf-Beast!
When the curious Summoner first laid hands upon this artifact, it emitted a haunting shriek. The terror it stirred within her was enough to predict her demise.
Now fated to perpetuate the Banshee's curse, the Summoner wielded power over lesser spirits.
Her robe, once boldly red, was reduced to ghostly tatters.
She would always carry an overpowering desire of revenge upon those that set her on this cursed path. She would pursue them for eternity.
When he heard about the horrifying Banshee at Septavius' side, the Archexorcist set out on his holiest quest yet, wielding an artifact wrested from the very hands of a God.
It takes zealotry bordering on madness to even dare utter the scathing words within this Tome. Its very contents blurred his vision and set his head to spinning. But he would dare.
He would face this threat wearing his most ceremonial garments.
The origin of the stone in this ring, and its connection to the staff that bore the Banshee's curse: a secret he would carry to his grave.
Lord Ruthven had acquired a veritable monster from who-knows-where. Luckily, her bullets cured lycanthropy.
She had the Archexorcist himself bless this trap. She hoped it would be enough to help catch a miscreation of this size.
Of course, a quirk of her... condition was the overwhelming desire to look great.
And still, she would not let the Vampire's curse she carried define her. Just as she would go on to rid others of their own curses. With violence, if needed.
A cloak that makes one's skin crawl with the dread of its short-lived former owner.
Tugging the bowstring fiber disrupts a delicate balance between the limbs of this bow, rapidly crystallizing the surrounding frost into a serrated bolt of hail.
Baneful beats of this waist-worn instrument rile the skies, invoking the occluded power of the storm.

Hardly attire of any sort, but rather a sustained cone of latent energy called forth by unseen wind spirits. Stray gusts glide beneath each step, affording both impressive speed and a thrilling lighter-than-air sensation.
A breathtaking amulet believed to portend the will of the storm. The large stone within faintly swirls, as though an entire cyclone were somehow petrified by force of the earth.

Strictly speaking, this is no wand at all, and rather blunt even for a channeling device. Yet its crude appearance belies a sophisticated tool of deterrence, a contrast very much in character for the spirits of the earth.

To fabricate colossi from within the earth is a rare and enviable practice, often deemed sacred. The creations of this club-like mace are too brittle for the interest of certain parties, but the proven potential is a precious thing indeed.
The practices of the earth mages died out with their bloodline, a consequence of notoriously being rather secretive types. But the traits of this garb, hardy and unyielding, tell much of their ways.

When etched into stone, this mark greatly amplifies one's resilience, as though it echoes the earth's power. Hollow relics like these are an oddity, as earth shamans regarded the designed permission of flowing air as a sign of severe fault.
A standard, lightweight sheath fit for enabling quick draws in a forward dash.
A dependable sheath carved of petrified wood, with a finely curved slot to optimize draw force.
A meticulously crafted sheath built of stretched vines and parallel blades of grass for a smoother blade release.
A curious sheath designed to evoke the effortless flow of clouds and fog.
A fierce sheath made to spill the blood of gods, briefly filling the wielder with a beastly aggression when a blade is drawn.
An elegant teal sheath with masterful snake etchings both inside and out, amplifying the momentum of a swift strike from the hip.
An extravagant gilded sheath which was once the heirloom of a distant clan, a now extinct bloodline whose intricate weapon arts remain in practice.
A marvelous sheath of inimitably brilliant constitution. Drawing one's blade from within emits a furious sonic wave, propelling the weapon beyond its known limits.
A detestably vengeful sheath consumed in the violet flames of Asura, a hateful deity scorned since the time of the ancients.
Archdemon Malphas took a conspicuous liking to this outsider's sheath, smuggled in by a newly demonic soul. Perhaps its design reminded him of something?
Still believing himself a monk, Daichi knew an open blade contrasts his superficial rank. Yet he could not bear to abandon his wicked material weapon, and so he forever concealed it with this sheath.

The Woodland Labyrinth is a lamentable example of mortal meddling in the ways of nature, a harsh reality its occupants are keenly aware of. A sheath like this, fully embracing their own ways of life, is no doubt a bitter expression of dissent.

A foreign sheath stolen from unknown lands by the crew of Davy Jones. Now phantoms, the headstrong ghost pirates have misused this delicate instrument as a rapier holder, twisting its effects with their chaotic ways.
Believed to be some kind of artificial organ, this sheath embeds the weapon in a solid crystal coating before violently fracturing into shrapnel when drawn.
Swift, ruthless, and a perfect encapsulation of Oryx's militia. Vicious aggression to overwhelm one's enemies has been the Mad God's tactic of choice since the day he earned his title.
An advanced flight test disguised as an arts and crafts project, or so its inventor continues to believe.
A glacial seal consumes any weapon held within, solidifying a layer of permafrost to enable smoother draws with the elegance of falling snow.
In the right hands, this fluid blade lashes out with stinging water whips. Such adept control over the wild waters is thought to be a sign of great achievement for any swordsman.
Masters of swordsmanship recognize how much can be learned from the flow of the ocean's waves.
Reinforced coral creates a form of shock absorbing plates, a crucial trait for surviving the high pressure of the ocean floor.
A keepsake held closely by Thessal, clinging to the unlikely chance of her king's continued wellbeing. Any sailor knows this slim hope is all that contains the true beast of the seas.
It's tasty and it will not ruin your pet's diet!
Some pets go nuts for it.
We have no idea what sort of apples were used to bake this pie, but all the pets seem to love it.
Ah yes, some people just like their solar potatoes mashed.
No actual turkeys were harmed during the making of this cake, they were only used as consultants.

A light powerful blade, capable of burning even the toughest opponents.
This sheath can be a great tool in the hands of an experienced Kensei.
Made of refractory material, this heavy armor is capable of summoning a powerful creature for extra defense.
A beautiful accessory which burns constantly to guide you through battle.
...a driving force, indeed the driving force of nature and of civilization, would drive us once again to...
We sought to ape its astonishing force, to reproduce it in our environment...
...the principle of things that are, Water could take all forms that make up our world, and we harnessed it...
...our Mother and our Essence and our livelihood... we would now seek its full potential.
Within this relic all elements swirl in perfect equilibrium. What would otherwise unleash cataclysmic disaster holds together in immaculate arcane homeostasis. We would surpass it.

And the Great Wave bore upon our dwellings, flushing us and our beasts and our tools... but one remained, and he held aloft his blade, and summoned to himself the powers that still haunted this place.
Our elder would look upon the storms and pondered on how a thing with no substance could leave but desolation in its wake.
What force would do but the very force behind life and movement? No other. This weapon would prove it.
She had read the tomes of other races, and she had the wisdom of the Earth. She saw how we must proceed.
Its pages are slightly damp and little of the ink remains readable after apparent water damage. It was a treatise on Water by an eminent sage, but someone has been scribbling in the margins.
Not many pages remain of this tome. It was a treatise on Air by a famous philosopher, but someone has been using it to seemingly keep records.
Most of this book has burned away. It was a treatise on Fire by an ancient scholar, but some of the text differs.
Most of its pages have been damaged or torn away. It was a treatise on Earth by a learned one, but it has been written on again at a later time.
This experimental device harnesses the power of lightning, allowing you to science your enemies senseless with raw energy.
Slamming this charred iron rod into the ground will summon elemental energies to blast anyone who comes close.
You can barely tell that this dress was taken from a poor bride who was buried in it.
This gigantic wig contains a lot of electrical energy due to being 90% wire wool.
The edge has been made blunt and ragged from smashing into trees, doors, walls, and pesky hikers.
This once held potatoes. Now it can barely hold back his rage.
The cloth does nothing to soften incoming attacks, but the blows only make the wearer angrier.
The teddy's head is down the well with the others.

As the nameless monarch sat malcontent upon the throne, his ambitions and impiety became one, and with this came enlightenment. A legacy reduced to less than legend, utterly erased from the nescient minds of the land, with its only epitaph being the sorry remnant of his majesty's dearest. After all, what good are kings in a realm of gods?
The symbol that claims absolute subservience from its beholder.
These intricately crafted blades were originally intended more for ornamental purposes rather than function, but still remain potent for any form of combat.
A set of knives wrapped in an ever burning flame.
Razor sharp gemstone blades that emit a faint, magic hum.
Blades wielded only by those among the strongest of mortals, their green edges gleam in sunlight.
Used primarily in ritual worship, repeated exposure to dark magic has imbued this pair of daggers with sinister powers.
Entire wars have been waged over the bloodstone of which a pair of these blades has been crafted from. A single pair carries the cost of thousands of deaths.
These blades are made from a material beyond the reaches of the realm, their origin shrouded in mystery, but their edge undoubtedly sharp.
The weight of a single swing carries the vigor of a hundred past heroes, their souls bound together in the shape of blades so they may once again slay evil.
A pair of weighty swords that carry with it thunderous strikes from its namesake.
Blades made from the bones of infernal beings, used to fell the same creatures it was forged from.
Tempered blades crafted from enchanted Darksteel and set with a gleaming ruby.
This dense set of blades has been crafted with the bones of beasts only spoken of through legend.
A pair of blades of unknown origin, within their edges a dark power can be felt, threatening to corrupt the user should they not be sated in battle.
Keen blades that never grow dull, their slashes threaten to split the very sky itself.
Weapons of striking beauty, their colors displaying all the shades of twilight, each slash like a brushstroke, painting its own landscape.
The culmination of countless generations of swordsmiths, each perfecting their craft and improving these blades gradually. The pinnacle of weapons created by mortals for use in slaying the immortal.
Commissioned by a particularly gaudy lord for his armies, this flail gleams as brightly as the armor he was once known to wear.
Often seen used in arenas across the lands, flails like these offer a perfect balance of weight and power.
Once wielded by a band of knights from atop their lightning drake companions, a thunderous roar can be heard with each swing.
Forged in the fires of the underworld, the mace atop this flail emits a heat reminiscent of its origins.
A masterpiece of craftsmanship with the strongest and most desirable of all metals, as deadly as it is egregiously expensive.
Granted only to heroes who have returned from missions of world saving renown. Those who receive it are cemented in legend.
Gifted from the heavens to the most righteous of mortals, these flails have been imbued with the power of angels to subjugate evil entities.
The primary armament of the gravelords of old, eternally tasked with making sure the dead are forever sealed away from the mortal plane.
An impossibly intricate pattern belies these blades, carved from a self-perfecting crystalline deity.
An extraordinarily dense silversteel anchor attached to a magical kelpwoven chain. Whatever ship it was attached to has long since been dragged to the depths.
Jagged obsidian and smooth malachite blades inscribed with runes and teeming with energy. The runes read as a eulogy for those lost while trying to seal a great evil.
Fractures run all along the limbs of this bow, which is momentarily shattered every time it is fired. A powerful magic reforms the bow immediately after each shot.
A flat gold blade set atop a wooden handle, wielded by Pharaohs that will one day ascend to divinity.
A brutal club teethed with obsidian blades crafted by the jungle tribes. The somewhat crude appearance masks and incredibly deadly weapon.

The blade of this weapon is plated with gold acting as a symbol of status among the eastern warriors that wield it. Its usage requires immense skill as an untrained user will put themselves at more risk than their opponent.

Traditionally used as a versatile weapon of war by the armies of the desert empires. This pair was used for ritual duels between opposing noble factions where nobles would send forth their best warriors to settle disputes.
Cutlass daggers, often used as a backup weapon when compared to a full sized blade, when dual wielded however a skilled captain can turn them into an unbeatable pair.

A rusty barrel once used for transporting a revolting toxin across the seas. One spilled drop is enough to cause a crew to jump ship with no regard for their own lives.

Unleash destruction with this brutal flail. Its massive anvil end shatters armor and crushes foes. Its craftsmanship whispers of an untamed, cataclysmic force.
Imbued with the untamed power of the Mighty Minotaur, this shield leaves a feeling of despair and no escape to those unfortunate enough to be in it's presence.
This mythical Minotaur chest plate infuses your weapon with a speed that mirrors the guardians of ancient labyrinths, making you the calm yet devastating eye of the cyclone in battle.
Slip on these savage Knuckles and unleash a whirlwind of swings, each powered by an uncanny dexterity that leaves foes questioning what hit them.
Unleash the untamed forces of electricity! This rod's damage output is as unpredictable as a storm, striking foes with bolts that range from a spark to a lightning blast.
Summons static Totems that discharge electrical bolts around it. The totem’s rapid fire makes it a formidable static defense.
This mystical armor amplifies your defenses and imbues you with the swiftness needed for rapid totem placement.
This enchanted pendant heightens your elemental abilities and agility, enabling quick placement of Storm Totems and devastating attacks.

Trim up the tree with Oryxmas stuff, like mistletoe and big cream puffs!
All who stand against the merry melodies of the holiday season will be jingle bell ROCKED.
The hot wax of this candle burns with the judgement of those who lack a giving spirit.
This festive axe is meant to chop wood for a cozy winter fireplace, but it could probably handle your enemies in combat too.
Candy canes, candy canes, lick them in a spear and kill your enemies!
Great for stringing along doors, railings, or the nock of an arrow before releasing.

Each blade is surrounded by a freezing mist, together they are cold enough to liquify air.
What was once a normal longbow wielded long ago has spent enough time frozen in shuffling layers of ice to become a mythical relic.
Light refracting through the crystalline tip of this spellblade is amplified to blinding degrees, though this is not the most powerful aspect of the weapon.
Held aloft, this magical focusing device will become charged with stellar power. It is favored by explorative types as it doubles as a compass.
This ball and chain of magical ice was dragged around by a helpless soul as the winter's chill seeped deeper and deeper into their cold, dead heart.
The beauty of these blades as they dance together, bathed in radiant light soothes the restless souls that they tear from the bodies of their victims. The joys of winter are many.
Expands your seasonal Forge once. After the season ends, it expands your normal Forge Chest once. If you acquire this item with a non-seasonal character, it will expand your non-seasonal forge.

Legends speak of a star touched by Horizon that pierces through the light of the heavens. As eons passed, the caged tyrant sharpened broken scales like razorblades, imbuing his hatred as inky black darkness to forge a dark myth into reality.
A rather peculiar instrument played by the sailors of the seven seas. Its music has the unique property of attracting parrots that will obey the musician's every command.

feedable.id: Staff of the Crystal Serpent Shiny
feedable.description: An ancient staff used both for sacrifice and communion with the gods.
Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.
An early prototype ring.

feedable.id: Sword of the Colossus Shiny New
feedable.description: A sword with an impossibly sharp edge. It has been designed with holy magic to slash like no other blade.
Made from a cherry tree branch. This wand was gifted by Xil to Daichi for bringing him into this world.
A worn and battered suit of armor embedded with a mystic gem that flows with magical strength.
A high-fructose ring that will give you pep, but hurt your concentration.

An ornately decorated buckler made from an array of crystalline stone. It is too frail to swing around, but it can somehow grow and mantle its wielder in a heavy crystal armor that releases shards upon receiving trauma.

feedable.id: Tome of the Mushroom Tribes Shiny
feedable.description: A long-lost druid's tome that catalogs medicinal mushrooms. It also has many pocket spaces that contain spore samples, which can be made fully grown through incantations.

A unique and enchanted musical instrument, specifically associated with the playful and mischievous nature of jokers.
Small particles of fire energy visibly buzz around inside the fiery eyes of this mace.
This tome contains the original ancient dragon archives.
As the Dragon Slayer shield is carried into battle, it serves not only as a bulwark against the wrath of dragons but also as a symbol of hope for those who stand against the opposing forces.
Legend has it that this precious gem is the crystallized essence of a fierce dragon's heart, imbued with the ancient magic that flows through the veins of these titanic creatures.

A medallion infused with the essence of Belladonna.
The gooey chocolate pellets attract the Hatchling, which fetches them back to the wielder along with bites taken out of whatever they are attached to.
The projectiles fired from this bio-mechanical weapon are so sticky that they glue themselves to the air for a moment before they start flying.
A solid ball of bio-chocolate on the end of a chain.  It is so heavy and dense that when it lands it can shatter stone.
These Tachi are made to mimic the flopped ears of an Easter Bunny, and they fly back towards the thrower in imitation of them too.
This severed tail of an Easter Queen can continue to produce molten chocolate at flesh-searing temperatures long after it has been cut free.
A rapid-firing cannon which hurls handfuls of broken Easter Egg shell at the victim, lacerating them with the sharp edges.
A festive piece of armor, complete with bells. Try not to get too crazy.
Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.
Dr. Terrible modeled this staff in the likeness of his creation as an experimental attachment to the M.E.R.V. design. To prevent overheating, the unstable energy discharges require a moment to cool.
Seemingly bleak at first, this prism has erratic magical properties looming inside, which affect the light it scatters in unforeseen ways.
A barrel filled to the brim with the cheapest ale money can buy. The cask is highly pressurized and must be handled with care, should it be dropped it is likely to explode violently.
The crystalline glass in this orb seals away an ancient flora said to rejuvenate the spirit and unleash one's force of will against those who threaten the wild.
An intricately crafted vessel, usually used to store the preserved internal organs, but this one seems to contain a cursed diety.
Crafted by a soul newly ensnared in the clutches of darkness, its design invoked memories of the fiery wrath of the god of chaos
This ancient spell scroll, adorned with intricate hieroglyphs depicting the sinuous forms of cobras, invokes the power of the serpentine deities. Whispering secrets of venomous potency.
Crafted from glistening ivory and adorned with shimmering gold, but seems carry an ancient protection spell coming from the Underworld.
This dagger arcs gracefully like the crescent moon.
Adorned in gold jewels and vibrant Egyptian blue, only the most skilled archers were given the right to wield such a magnificent bow.
This staff is rumored to have devastating power when under the influence of an eclipse.
The power of this rod comes from the glimmering glow of the sun, when shinned on top of the highest pyramid its power will really show.
Iconic to ancient Egypt, this curved blade was both used in warfare and ceremonies.
This blade gleams brightly blinding foes with every swing.
A faithful and comfortable scarf that has witnessed countless journeys. Imbued with a protective enchantment, it allows its wearer to gracefully weave through perilous situations.
Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.

An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.

A majestic trident adorned with enchanted coral formations that enables command of the tides. Once wielded by King Alexander in his conquest of the oceans, its power has since faded with each passing moon from natural weathering.

A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.

A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.
A sinister twist on the scarecrow's intended use. Totalia bewitched these cursed figures with an uncanny allure to enthral victims into their untimely demise.

An ancient volume recording ancestral lineages dating as far back as the Primal Era. Infused with the essence of druidic magic, it grants the power to delve into nature's eternal transformation, morphing its caster into formidable creatures.
Survival of the fittest.
Survival of the fittest.
Survival of the fittest.

A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.

A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.
An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.
Inhale, exhale.
Inhale, exhale.
Call forth a cute frog companion!

Call forth a cute crab companion!

A foreign sheath stolen from unknown lands by the crew of Davy Jones. Now phantoms, the headstrong ghost pirates have misused this delicate instrument as a rapier holder, twisting its effects with their chaotic ways.
Small particles of energy visibly buzz around inside the glistening crystals of this mace.
An astronomically heavy katana. It is forged from dark matter.
The gouged eye of the ferocious F.E.R.A.L. It is no longer potent enough to generate energy beams, but the beast's psychic vision still instinctively lashes back at aggressors.

A glacial robe worn by the witch doctors of a bygone ice tribe during their sacred burial ceremonies. The passage of time has encased the cloth in a layer of permafrost, chilling those who fracture its coat.
Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.
Coral from the depths of the ocean which has formed into a natural ring. Painful to put on and take off, but very rare and therefore desirable.
An ancient ship's bell encrusted with dried deep kelp and bearing obscure sigils of forgotten, underwater gods. Its peals can summon fish to defend the bearer, but at what cost?
A rusted piece of Kogbold machinery recovered from the depths of the ocean. The only question is, how did it get on a thousand-year-old shipwreck?
Ancient legends say that the Phantom Diver never misses when he tosses this terrible harpoon. The fact these legends cannot be traced back to before last week is not important.
A surprisingly modern explosive for breaching boats below the waterline. Don't forget to run when you throw it to avoid the blast!
The glowing tatters of an old diving suit. The wearer must be a spooky ghost, and not three Kogbolds standing on each other's shoulders.
Thick, lead ingots used to keep a diver's feet on the floor. They are definitely not gold bars being smuggled out of a secret mine.
Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.
This shimmering shield allows knights to enhance their concentration on targets, giving them more time to think about their next move in battle.
A wakizashi used by a powerful swordsman in ancient times. It seems to dance through the air as you swing it.
Believed to have been lost in a bygone era, this spell was recovered from ruins infested by horrific creatures of unknown origin. The scroll is still steeped with parasitic organisms.
A thin hood with a faded golden lace worn for sacrificial ceremonies. It has an aura of evil around it.
This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.
Made from Superburger and Spice of Life. This ultimate burger, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.
Made from Oryx Cookie and Spice of Life. This ultimate cookie, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.
Made from Power Pizza and Spice of Life. This ultimate slice of pizza, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.
This helm was forged of metal that fell from the sky.  It is strangely light and emits a faint hum.

feedable.id: Helm of the Juggernaut Shiny - Midas
feedable.description: This helm was forged of metal that fell from the sky.  It is strangely light and emits a faint hum.
This skull glows with the stolen soul of a phoenix trapped in the skull many years ago by Shaitan.
A fragment of Lord Ruthven's curse manifest itself into this pulsating dagger. Its formless state allows it to cut in ways no other weapon could.

Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.
A mysterious quiver formed of corruption and dark matter. Its ethereal existence creates a small implosion of nearby atmosphere when drawn.
Decorated with ancient amber, this helmet's idle solitude over many years have caused its abilities to dwindle.
Her blade of choice was cursed to be unfit to harm the likes of gods. Through accursed soul binding, she found a means to adapt this curse into a terrifying weapon.

The death throes of a powerful demigod remain sealed within the crystalline exterior, but are briefly unleashed as the soul desperately attempts to cling onto life, pulling onto the life force of nearby souls only to strengthen its prison further.
A well-worn studded leather that has witnessed many battles and many more losses. It is the common wear of those who must bear the burden of burying those forever lost to the fight against the gods.
Concentrated within this gemstone are souls of vengeance, burning to serve one final role to smite the oppressors of the living.

A pristine cloud of nebular stardust gently rests atop a focusing rod in a tranquil stasis, until it is catalyzed into a microscopic genesis of stellar proportions. It is a reminder of the thin divide between uncreation and creation, a transcendental dance of the cosmos.

A glassy projection of arcanic lights provide an accurate chart of the stars beyond the Realm. Through a careful process of measurement and divination, one can travel along ley lines of starlight to reach worlds unknown.
What was once the simple vestments of an astronomer have become a curtain of stardust and dreams, a priceless record of countless travel through worlds that may never be visited again.

A crystalline formation in the shape of an eye remains the sole artifact of the journey’s true purpose- a secret beyond the stars waiting to be discovered. Beyond the dark horizons of the cosmic plane, what else has Cronus left behind for the explorers of the present to discover?
Can be used in the Forge to craft Spellbound Soulthief Trickster Items.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Astral Arcanist Mystic Items.
A legendary weapon whose attacks are said to be as intense as its red color. Rumor has it that this may not even be the original.
Another orb in an endless myriad of orbs for heroes to collect. What makes this specific shape so special?
No matter how you look at this garment, it is always distinctly black and red, with no in-between shades.
It is hard to make out what is on top of this ring. Maybe it is an eye or some sort of gem?
This covering is assigned to Oryx's negotiators to conceal weaponry and get away with stolen fortunes.
The diplomacy of Chancellor Dammah goes as far as his limited patience. The true purpose of this robe is its deeply woven enchantment to bolster arcane powers.
This cursed robe overwhelms the wearer with conflicting thoughts of good and evil, shattering the will of the weak-minded.
Specially weighted plates layered inside this armor channel greater force into every motion of the body for destructive blows.
Although refurbished, this breastplate is the very same Oryx received as a gift from the royal family in celebration of his gladiatorial prowess.
An arachnid star which slings silk to tangle predators while granting oneself the speed and stamina of Arachna's most agile young.

feedable.description: A pitch black cloak enhanced with the defensive strength of Oryx's own signature armor.
An intricate scepter of unfathomable power containing the electric fluids of a jellyfish behemoth.
A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.

A tried and tested weapon used extensively by Commander-Lord Carosburg's soldiers.  It has a good weight for chopping, and a fine edge which can slice through most armour.
Cronus made many prototypes for different wands, with this being one of his most popular amongst his students, as the shots can injure a target in the past as well as the present.
A swift and deadly dagger used as a backup weapon by soldiers in Commander-Lord Carosburg's armies.  It is also very useful by itself, and has ended many lives on the battlefield.
While it appears to the untrained eye that this bow only fires three arrows, it actually fires hundreds across all dimensions, as Cronus designed it to hit every possible variation of the target.
Out of respect for their missing teacher, students of Cronus will mount a stone mask of his face to a staff to use as a focus.  They will often wear these masks or use them as ornaments as well.
A frighteningly sharp blade from the eastern lands, modified for use in Commander-Lord Carosburg's forces by executioners and elite duellists.
Balanced between might and mysticism, the leather and metal of this light armour provides good protection and mobility.
Polished to a high sheen, these banded plates proudly announce the prowess of the wearer in battle. Only the best of Commander-Lord Carosburg's foot troops are qualified to wear them.
Robes which signify the wearer follows the wisdom of the missing magus – Chronus. The small death masks worn as charms are said to symbolise his teachings.

This brilliant diamond exhibits a peculiar agitation to exposure beyond the waters. It was plundered by the Pirate Queen herself from depths far deeper than the open seas, as it was believed to be the boon of an ancient oceanic deity.
This sacred blade may be unsheathed in the blink of an eye to produce a catastrophic blast of lightning. Such a tool is used by Izel to bring fervor and great respect to the many gods of the thicket.

A depraved aura of malignance exudes from this relic. Once protected within the great tombs of the desert, Nefret unearthed this treasure to prevent it and many others from falling into the hands of the Legion.
Once nameless tools of an oni warrior, these blades have witnessed the bloodshed of a thousand lives lost to Oryx. They carry the whispers of a long-sought vengeance against the Exalted One.

A famous boxer once said the secret to their victory was having a great right hook, this dagger’s craftsman took that literally.
A ceremonial pungi that contains the spirits of fifteen snakes, guiding the righteous through their many paths ahead.
A slow but powerful sword that is a relic of a long forgotten age.
A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.
Cut from a fallen star, a deep purple emanating an unearthly glow, hinting at the power fused within.
A great katana charged with the power of the sun itself.
How can something with so many holes in it be useful in defence? By spinning it so quickly nobody can strike you through the holes, of course!
This ancient, cursed treasure map causes treasure to appear in front of the caster.  As the coins and jewels overlap in physical space this causes a massive explosion.
Pirates will not admit it, but they can't recall all the rules and regulations of piracy.  So they write them all down in books like these which become sacred relics of piracy.
Arrows placed in this quiver become encrusted with a layer of sea salt, and turn into augurs of seawater when fired.
Some say this skull is the model used in the original Jolly Roger, but that seems a little unlikely.  It is still super powerful, whatever the truth.
This parrot was struck by lightning while perched in the crow's nest.  It has remained rigid and crackling with chained power to this very day.
Shaping raw magic into spirit-like forms, phantasmal projectiles are launched, each one homing in on the target with the precision of a well trained archer.
A ghastly ring that calls upon the eager hands of an impossible undead creature.
