A light and breezy costume you can wear to dress up as a hooded treat-seeking Mystic!
A proper habit would be woven in a more durable manner than this, but it works just fine for dressing up as a patient, safety-aware Priestess!
You'll smell more like Halloween spirit than of newfound riches, but it suits just perfectly for dressing up as an enterprising Rogue.
These type of coats are more likely to be found at an anime convention with their shoddy quality, but it's just right for cosplaying the beautiful Ninja.
Foam and PVC don't make for as durable armor as Mithril, but it'll do for an accurate lookalike of the steadfast Knight.
This costume is rather itchy and reeks of a strange glue-like scent, but it's par for the course for dressing as the furry Warrior.
A medallion infused with the essence of Soulwarden Murcian.
A luminescent vial containing an eerie liquid, extracted through the complete pulverization of a soul.
A weapon used by Skuld's soul collectors to absorb and send souls to their final destinations.
Two of Groundskeeper Gretch's most coveted tools, tainted by a powerful curse that draws out the life essence of its user to maintain their finesse.
A tattered piece of cloth crudely fashioned into a robe, barely capable of covering its wearer. However, what it lacks in physical durability is made up with a thick barrier of mana.

An extremely heavy axehead salvaged from Griefkeeper Zole's rather bulky choice of weaponry. Throwing it takes a tremendous amount of effort, but it has the capacity to obliterate everything in its path.

A faintly magical device used by Griefkeeper Zole to amplify his own voice throughout the Penitentiary's cell branch. Peculiarly, speaking into it warps any attempts at encouragement into toxic insults.
A chilling metal container filled with miscellaneous medical instruments coated in poison. Its syringes require blood as a catalyst, taking a considerable toll on both victim and user alike.

A tightly-woven garment used to restrain the mentally insane in the Penitentiary's torture branch. The echoed laughs of its past users can be faintly heard while wearing it, and intensify as its wearer takes damage.
The incredibly thick cornea taken from the eye of Overseer Oculon. It bears an immense hunger for magical energy, and will devour its user's entire mana pool in the blink of an eye.
A questionably sentient artifact smuggled from the Penitentiary's administration branch. Repeatedly irritating the summoned entity causes it to spew corrosive tears in a large area.
An uncannily heavy iron ball and chain utilized by Murcian himself, burdened by the weight of countless souls that met their fate at the hands of the warden.
A much more refined cane than its predecessor, imbued with unwilling spirits that lost their way towards the afterlife.

A specially engineered concoction containing a modified plague virus, allowing the direct infection of a victim's soul. Although it can infect over a massive area, the particular lack of lethality makes it seem incomplete.
Empowering the mystic gem embedded in this armor caused it to violently disintegrate its former shell. Fitted into a new plating, it now massively increases its wielder's capacity for magical energy.
A nearly restored version of a once historical amulet, with the previous gem resocketed into a new metallic frame. It seems to have regained more of its ancient power.
Once a mystical artifact that allowed its bearer to escape the grasp of death, this amulet remains as a relic of Murcian's past involvement with Skuld. Wearing this amulet is ill-advised.

Summons Murcian and his staff to follow you around the realm! Wait a second, how did they escape...?\n\nRewarded to Marshmalla, TLMaelstrom, Sheepsmall, and Idontgiveawhale for their work on Spectral Penitentiary.
An infinite generator for the Spectral Penitentiary contributor reward.
An ominous looking safe from the Tinkerer's vault. It contains extraordinary items.
A bowl filled with rewarding soup. You're not quite sure what's inside, but getting it down your stomach makes you feel tough enough to do involuntary labor.
Contains information on how to combine reactants together in the Spectral Penitentiary.
Unlocks the Jailer's Scythe in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Tools of the Tarnished in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Wretched Rags in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Overwhelming Axehead in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Motivational Megaphone in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Sinister Syringes in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Cackling Straitjacket in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Command Cornea in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Ocular Entrapment in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks Damnation in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction, or used to substitute a Spectral Penitentiary item.
Unlocks the Amulet of Desecration in the Item Forge.
Adult male basilisks are apex predators, and at full maturity their tails gain the unique ability to release piercing acid from the tip.

This electrical rod is actually used to remove rust from machine parts through electrolysis. When used on a living or artificial creature however, the shock causes muscles to tense and circuits to go haywire, reducing the assailant's power.
A crude walking stick enchanted by Skuld's distinct style of sorcery, constructed to guide fallen spirits to the afterlife.
An ancient druidic spell that invokes earth spirits into furnishing the soil with a noxious, deadly skullshroom colony.
A seal that is said to briefly borrow the power of the Gods themselves.  Some Paladins shun its dark power, others embrace it.
Archdemon Malphas took a conspicuous liking to this outsider's sheath, smuggled in by a newly demonic soul. Perhaps its design reminded him of something?
Rumored to be found deep in the aquatic ocean abyss, the fallen souls that reside within this guitar scream to be heard.
Forged in the hot lavas of the abyss, this pick has a dark influence over the player. The more they play, the stronger the possession becomes.
Torn from a powerful demon, these wings carry a dark energy that grant the wearer flight and confidence.
The longer you wear it, the more you feel in tune with the darker forces of the realms, rumored to cause red skin.
A powerful weapon once wielded by a God of thunder. Striking this legendary weapon allows the wielder to smite opposition with the might of thunderstorms.
Designed for carving and also used to create bolts of thunder, smiting those that oppose justice.
Traditional garments characterized by flowing robes, wide sleeves, and intricate designs.
A string of prayer beads made from a combination of wood, seeds and gemstones. This ancient relic emboldens the wearer during meditation and spiritual practices.
A rod composed of solid foramite, the only known material in the galaxy capable of withstanding the corrosive effects of Foraxian acid.
A stunning bow forged in the heat of a massive star many lightyears beyond the realm.
A set of daggers given partial sentience by alien technology. They fiercely compete to claim more kills than the other.
Though rather unremarkable as far as alien weapons go, Malogian clans swear by this weapon as a good luck charm. Some things never change.
A superior apron crafted from turkey hide, perfect for the culinary warrior who fears no grease splatter!
A dazzling apron woven from the finest metallic threads, perfect for conjuring up enchanted stuffing.
This apron may look like standard chef's gear, but it's reinforced with cast-iron pots and enchanted oven mitts. Perfect for those who fear neither battle nor boiling oil!
A ring made from a splinter of crystallized sacrificial bone.
This prism has a deep flaw that causes it to scatter light in two directions.
A bow fashioned from living coral found in only the deepest ocean trenches.  It is the favored weapon of those that inhabit the realms beneath the waves.
An ancient weapon imbued with the power of the cosmos.
Battle armor made from Fire Dragon scales, one of the strongest substances this world has ever seen.

A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.
A golden rat that serves as a good luck charm!
A peculiar instrument used by rat hunters of yore to lure rodents to their demise.
A conventional tool used by rat hunters to snare rodents. Although simple, it proves to be timelessly effective.
The swirling swings of this scythe can slice through bone as if it were a feeble stalk.\n\nSprite Credits: TLMaelstrom
The swirling swings of this scythe can slice through bone as if it were a feeble stalk.\n\nSprite Credits: TLMaelstrom
A bow of unbelievable weight. It requires multiple Kogbold Workers to fire a single arrow.
An unknown Kogbold appendage, seemingly more machine than flesh.
An unbearably heavy sword said to harness the soul of a Kogboldian master craftsman.
A rather unusual ratcheting blade used by the Kogbolds to tighten the bolts on the Kogbold Steamwalker.
A well machined object said to give the Kogbolds their strength.
The KI132 Bladed Multitool finds its way into the hands of many Kogbold Engineers sent out on expeditions. It is equipped with blades for any situation, as well as a handy pair of pliers.
A ghastly ring that calls upon the eager hands of an impossible undead creature.
A questionably sentient artifact smuggled from the Penitentiary's administration branch. Repeatedly irritating the summoned entity causes it to spew corrosive tears in a large area.
A necessary component for any beer-drinking or sausage-eating in the month of October.\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron
The harbinger will tread through the Tundra, uncaring of the life that may have ended at the hands of the deepsteel blade.
To whom this symbol belonged, and what it may have represented, remains a mystery. It serves as a grim reminder of the world unobserved, cloaked in the endless snow.
The armor from the pitiful resistance was absorbed into this endless deepsteel plate. As the blizzard rages on, the plates grow ever more dense.
In the white wastes, Squall answers no prayers, spares no lives, and grants no solace.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Frost Harbinger Paladin Items.
The Advisor would come to know that power is given to the opportune, and those who would adapt and utilize the Frost would be capable of becoming its master.

The Harbinger's power was used to sublimate icicles along this blade, sending many sharp projectiles towards potential foes. He would soon learn that this was useful against more than just those who would oppose the Eternal Frost.
The suit, capable of withstanding the great cold, represented a pact between a mortal and an ever-living elemental being. Humans however, live too short lives to keep promises.
Perhaps at some point, a man wore this pendant in search of something that humans could possibly offer. As the pendant lost meaning, it became a reminder that what he sought was not of mortal nature.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Frost Advisor Samurai Items.
A shield from a place beyond the gates of war and peace.
A deadly substance concocted with ingredients found in the sewers.
A sickly piece of armor, grown from the twisted bark from one of the few remaining Ent Ancients that still populate the Sulfurous Wetlands.
This ornate herding staff composed of an old willow branch has been warped beyond mortal comprehension due to prolonged influence of the twisted beings of the Sulfurous Wetlands.
A dagger that was condemned to Davy Jones' Locker.
A horn claimed from Oryx's iconic helmet. To hold this in one's hand is a monumental insult to the Mad God's ego.
The battle standard of Beisa's forces, a sign of triumph for Oryx and calamity for those he faces.
A majestic crown of the venerated, bestowed upon Archbishop Leucoryx to solidify his position in Oryx's legion.
Treasurer Gemsbok had this monocle custom made to enhance his perception in stealth strikes.
The warped mind of Oryx's appointed chancellor. This cursed object thrives in the presence of demented energies.
The frostbitten winds whisper her name, and the blades sing of her sorrow.
This wand is powerful at conducting magical energy into a devastating blast.

This formerly ordinary mace was twisted by Arachna's son after plucking it from a hapless victim. Though he has no reason to use it himself, some believe the Son of Arancha keeps it as reminder to his kin to not cross him as he did his mother.
Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.
This Orb creates a concentrated area of energy. The energy is so dense at its core that foes are paralyzed.
An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.
A bulky cloak ill-suited for stealth, but can provide the wearer with great offensive capabilities.
A set of finely crafted, balanced throwing knives designed with the precision and flair of circus performers.
A katana of unparalleled grace and agility, the Acrobat's Edge is a weapon crafted for both elegance and performance.
A fierce yet elegant weapon.Both intimidating and masterfully crafted, the Lion's Tamer is a weapon that commands respect and awe, perfect for those who wield strength with precision and showmanship.
A staff of mystic allure, a tool for weaving illusions and conjuring wonders straight from the imagination.
A bow of striking elegance and authority, crafted to captivate both audiences and adversaries.
A wand brimming with whimsical power, the Carnival's Conjurer is a masterpiece of artistry and magic.

It is believed that astral stardust landed during the Primal Era, giving life to these now-extinct flowers that adapted to any environment they bloomed from. Consecrated by the infernal spirits of old, these artifacts now serve as a token of friendship with the elementals of the deep earth.
Unlocks the Igneous Starblossom in the Item Forge. Also, one blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction.
Shaped from the stingers of mutant beehemoths, these blades are sealed away until the very moment of combat and brandished by the finest of shinobee.
Unlocks the Combcutter Kunai in the Item Forge. Also, one Blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction.
A lovely katana made for those who fight with passion and seek true love.
A delicately engraved gem that captures the light of timeless love.
A sweet and protective armor, crafted from rich chocolate, made for those who cherish the spirit of Valentine's Day.
A beautifully crafted ring shaped like a heart, symbolizing the sweetness of love.
A wakizashi with a unique edge, crafted to release a burst of sugary energy. Perfect for those who wield both sweetness and strength.
A strong armor made from layers of rich cake and cream, offering both protection and a tasty, comforting spirit.
The Legendary Sword of the Cube God, is a blade of unparalleled power, forged from the essence of the almighty Cube God itself.
While the majority of the Disciples of Cronus generally favored lighter weaponry, a scant few could be found wielding massive blades of immense weight and equal power.
Consecrating the divine energies of Primal Snakes into a blend of juniper and mugwort creates a regenerative infusion far more potent than medicine known to the current world.
To create this sacred extract, Eden harvested hundreds of species of medicinal flora, all of which have thought to have been long extinct from the Primal Era.
The empyreans thought otherwise, but I would not remain sealed. For my embrace reaches the whole Realm, and my will is eternity.
A cobbled together suit of armor made from a beer barrel, while lacking in real defensive properties, its alcoholic aura numbs the wearer's pain against attacks.

A faintly magical device used by Griefkeeper Zole to amplify his own voice throughout the Penitentiary's cell branch. Peculiarly, speaking into it warps any attempts at encouragement into toxic insults.
This sword's blade is infused with magical essence, causing it to fire out violently upon lunging. That same magical force pulls the blade back to its hilt after striking.
A cursed piece of Davy Jones' treasure. Using it leaves behind a deadly spirit bomb.

A colossal gauntlet of masterful composition. Its sheer size is disproportionate for most warriors, only able to be worn on one's forearm as a bracer. A once glossy exterior faded from battle long ago, yet the sturdiness of its make is as resolute as it ever was.
A flora-infested skull from one of Belladonna's victims. It exchanges the life force it steals into plant life, blooming powerful vegetation.\n\nSprite Credits: TLMaelstrom
A mystical clover infused with a golden brew.
An even more ancient relic of the Tomb of the Ancients, once used by holy worshippers in ceremonies. It turns your character into the Pharaoh Necromancer upon equip!
A very gilded artifact discovered in the temple of El Dorado, presumably belonging to none other than Xolotl himself. It turns your character into the Dark Master Wizard upon equip!
A not so uncomfortably squishy piece of headgear that the Royal Cnidarian probably wants back. It turns your character into the Dark Knight Trickster upon equip!
A not so ordinary mask covered in copious amounts of sludge from the Toxic Sewers. It turns your character into the Slurp King Knight upon equip!
A deadly repeater crossbow and a marvel of craftsmanship. This mechanical weapon is efficient, but carries additional weight.
Firing from this quiver uniquely applies the force of the bowstring as potential energy, which is then overcharged and converted to kinetic energy for a delayed, yet intensely powerful release.
Still believing himself a monk, Daichi knew an open blade contrasts his superficial rank. Yet he could not bear to abandon his wicked material weapon, and so he forever concealed it with this sheath.

feedable.id: Not Shiny Trap of the Vile Spirit
feedable.description: A long lost artifact recovered by Davy Jones, believed to have been cursed by the gods of the seven seas themselves.

feedable.id: Shiny Trap of the Vile Spirit
feedable.description: A long lost artifact recovered by Davy Jones, believed to have been cursed by the gods of the seven seas themselves.
A shield made of snake skin stretched across a rigid frame.
The blade of this dagger was once the enormous Killer Bee Queen's stinger. It remains exceptionally sharp, and could easily cut through even the heaviest of armor in a single strike.
A bow believed to have only been fired in dissent against the heavens. In retribution, the empyrean rulers have cursed this device to tether its wielders in shackles of divine light.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the K.I.D.D. Force to create the K.I.D.D. Force 2.0. Upgraded with even less shades, this staff has really come around.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the MMace MMurderer to create the FFabulous FFlail. A MMace that can be MMasterfully FFlung, FFrequently FFlying FFabulously albeit with slight miscalculations.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of Mister Mango to create the Groovy Mango. This jamming mango was given the time to sweeten and ripen into a groovy party rocking entity.
After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Butter Bow to create the Baked Bow. This bow showcases the power of butter, enjoy these tasty baked treats.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Caduceus of Current Craziness to create the Caduceus Of Enlightened Chaos. Using this wand allows the user to reach their full chaotic potential and understand their role in battle; be unpredictable and let someone else deal with it.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Blade of Ages to create the Blade of Blooming. Nature would slowly takeover this blade blooming with beautiful roses.
All that glitters is not gold. Beware, tricksters who choose this dastardly prism must be committed to their cruel prank.
Exceptional leather armor crafted from the hardened shell of an ancient, mythical egg-bearing creature.
A vibrant robe woven from enchanted carrot fibers, its rich orange hue infused with the essence of the earth. Worn by the reclusive gardeners of the Verdant Order.
Resilient enchanted chainmail forged from the finest molten chocolate, crafted for the legendary confectioner knights of the Sweetforge Dominion.
Leather armor made from the durable hide of a roc.
Leather armor made from the protective skin of hippogriffs.
Superior leather armor made from the magical hide of a griffon.
Superlative leather armor fashioned from the skin of a twelve-headed swamp hydra.
Outstanding leather armor made from the virtually impregnable hide of a great desert wyrm.
A highly decorated robe of purple wizardcloth, imbued with powers of sorcery and darkness.
A robe of rarest moonsilk, enhanced long ago with deep nocturnal enchantments.
A brightly colored robe of metallic threads, woven in the ancient elvish style and steeped in fey auras.
A bloodweft robe adorned with rubies and firegarnets, worn by an ancient sect of masterful wizards.
A robe of gossamer glowthread, used by the sorceress matriarchs of the western kingdoms.
Magical cold plate armor inscribed with tales of destruction and murder.
Tremendously strong plate armor shrouded by an aura of demonic revenge.
Mighty felplate armor designed for the most powerful of demon lords.
Indestructible magical armor made for the elite stoneborn champions of the eastern citadels.
Exquisitely decorated adamantine armor smithed by underdeep dwarves for the wardens of the demonclefts.
A sharp druidic dagger vibrating with primal energies.
A deadly dagger of glittering magical emerald.
A dagger of rare purple agate, infused with powerful dark magics.
A crimson felsteel dagger saturated with evil magic and primordial hatreds.
A moonsteel dagger of the underworld, corrupted by loathsome enchantments and profane spells.
A highly effective bow fashioned of still-living magical springwood.
A powerful bow crafted by dryads and blessed by the spirits of the woodlands.
A runed bow steeped in the dark power of ancient injustice.
A diamondwire bow used by guardians of the unseen ethereal shrines.
A superlative bow of sunsteel and diamondwire, created by a secretive race of star-dwelling entities.
A golden staff imbued with the powers of death magic.
An imposing golden staff of tremendous otherworldly power.
A splendid golden staff of astonishing power, bathed in light and brimming with magical energy.
A golden staff of transcendent understanding, made from crystals present at the formation of the universe.
A golden staff of elysian consciousness, shining with the base power of empyrean truths.
A mysterious wand of otherworldly origin, imbued with the purest of arcane energies.
A wand of demonic enigmas, cloaked in darkness and crackling with dark enchantments.
A centuries-old wand of great power, heralding long-destined destruction.
A great golden wand of the heavens, created by angels to wreak justice on the slayers of the innocent.
A shining gold wand of force, built by a diabolic archmagus to channel vast corrupting energies into the material plane.
A sword forged in a great volcano and consecrated with dragon magic.
A sword pulsing with the powerful magic of ancient beings.
An unfathomably powerful sword wielded by titanic air elementals in their great war of revolution.
A great sword of recognition, forged by the gods for the champions of humankind.
An exalted weapon of the august kings of old, hallowed with the spirit of nations and yearning to grant power anew.
A mighty katana with a crystal eye embedded in the hilt.
One of the legendary great blades of the master Ichimonji.
An evil blade that hungers for blood.
A magnificent legendary blade which only cuts those who deserve death.
A formidable blade that was meticulously crafted over the course of several centuries by the most renowned masters in history.
An exceptional cloak used by sorcerer-thieves for night operations in dockyards and storehouses.
A powerful cloak used by master spies to infiltrate the most tightly guarded fortresses.
A powerful cloak woven from the shadows of twilight.
An eldritch cloak of the afterworld which grants invisibility by enveloping its user in death itself.
A powerful enchanting quiver made by forest elves.
A superior enchanting quiver made of high quality magesteel.
A quiver that shines with gold and pulses with the power of elvish archer spirits.
A forestcloth quiver of highest quality, exhibiting exceptional magic powers and used by the foremost masters of Elven archery.
A formidable fire spell used by dwarven magi in their war against the trolls.
An immensely powerful spell created by the wizard lords of the underworld to harness dark energies.
An unimaginably destructive spell, devised by the great mountain thaumaturgists to battle against demonic giants.
A horrifically dangerous spell, formulated in the elemental planes during the great astral wars.
A sacred tome, consecrated by the spirits of the upright and the supplications of the pure.
An angelic tome, empowered by divine might and justified by the souls of the righteous.
A sanctified tome, blessed by the heavens and purified by ancient rites, trembling with unseen divine power.
A tome of blessing, gifted by the gods for the benefit of all good mortals.
A major's helm of ornate red iron, made to arouse fearlessness among the troops.
A well-made commander's helm of steel with silver filigree, able to inspire gallantry in large numbers of troops.
A golden field marshal's helm with platinum detailing and a cockatrice plume, able to motivate entire legions to new heights of tenacity and determination.
A steel and platinum helm of ancient design, worn by earthrazer generals during the great orcish war.
A steel shield supported by iron ribbing.
An ornate but strong shield plated with gold.
A very strong shield made from the strongest and most desirable of all metals.
A superior shield forged in deep armories for the construct armies of the underworld.
A seal of blessed preservation, gleaming with the sacred will of the righteous.
A consecrated seal of the heavens, shining with divine brilliance and godly power.
A hallowed seal of the immortal divine, sanctified by the pious and used since ancient times to inspire great numbers of crusading warriors.
A holy seal of heavenly omnipotence, given to aid mortal warriors in their fight against chaos and darkness.
Lethal aquatic poison extracted from the glands of the magical demon ray.
Magically refined poison of the rare and dangerous felwasp.
Magically enhanced venom of the savage nightwing dragon.
Concentrated, lethal venom of the winged ethereal baneserpent.
A holy paladin's skull, fouled by depraved incantations of necromancy.
A lesser demon's skull, empowered and amplified by dark enchantments of the underworld.
A powerful demon skull permeated with unspeakably horrific sorceries.
The skull of a vampire lord, further desecrated with the depraved magics of soul thievery.
A mighty trap strong enough for the most vicious of magical beasts.
A potent trap powered by angelic spirits, used by demon hunters in the nether realms.
A powerful magic trap charged with astral energies and used by the legendary dragon slayers of ancient times.
A most effective magical trap used in the titan wars to hobble even the largest of enemy combatants.
A glowing orb of pale emerald, used to constrain rogue elementals to the astral mists.
A powerful orb of flawless sun quartz, created by dark thaumaturgists of the nether kingdoms.
An orb of pure diamond, shining with an eerie blackness and thirsting to consume the life essence of mortals.
An orb of astral amethyst, crystallized beneath the titanic mountains of the earth plane and used to secure dangerous creatures in distant realms.
A mind-affecting prism that creates powerful psychic illusions.
A glittering magical prism that fabricates potent images in the minds of the weak-willed.
A prism of the underworld that harnesses dark energy to implant noncorporeal psionic beings into the minds of onlookers.
A deep blue prism of sun cut topaz, used by doppelganger spies to aid in their vile missions of assassination and murder.
A glittering golden scepter charged with magical lightning.
A golden scepter of power, created by storm giants during their long war against the undertrolls.
A commanding scepter of authority, wielded by cloud titan nobles from the elemental plane of air.
An ancient druidic scepter created by the nature gods themselves, embodying all the fury of the megacosm.
A beautifully crafted shuriken.
A sacred shuriken that embodies the power and speed of the wind.
A mystical shuriken formed from ever-frozen ice.
An ancient weapon that spells destruction for all who oppose its master.
A heavy wakizashi created and used by a secluded sect of powerful swordsmen.
A beautiful wakizashi, adorned with shining gemstones found within the extensive cavern, Okina Tomi.
A wakizashi adorned with sea green stones, only given to the greatest swordsmen by the Grand Emperor himself.
A gorgeous wakizashi made of starmetal and gifted to an ancient king by the god Shinsetsuna for his devotion.
A polished lute built for combat against undead menaces.
A lightweight lute designed to project strong sounds across the chaos of battlefields.
An immaculate lute granted to the appointed bards of wealthy rulers as their travel companions.
A misty lute created by the exalted songweavers in their task to awaken the wind deity Shu.
A decorated mace of high status, signifying achievement in advanced summoning styles.
An imposing mace built specifically for battle application, staggering foes with its intimidating design.
A majestically grand mace used in royal courts as a show of formidable might.
An opulent mace built of dense nightmatter and enchanted to harness the power of the infinite void for unspeakably powerful summoning.
A curious sheath designed to evoke the effortless flow of clouds and fog.
A fierce sheath made to spill the blood of gods, briefly filling the wielder with a beastly aggression when a blade is drawn.
An elegant teal sheath with masterful snake etchings both inside and out, amplifying the momentum of a swift strike from the hip.
An extravagant gilded sheath which was once the heirloom of a distant clan, a now extinct bloodline whose intricate weapon arts remain in practice.
A large topaz set in a glittering gold ring.
A very large topaz set in a dazzling gold ring.
A huge, flawless topaz set in a stunningly beautiful gold ring.
An immaculately perfect topaz embedded in an exquisite gold ring.
As fleeting as the season itself, but as potent as the first bloom of spring.
As the wind whispers through the morning air, it strikes with both elegance and intent.
Like the first crack of dawn after a long winter, it shields with both strength and grace.
Like a fragile egg waiting to hatch, it holds immense potential within its delicate shell.
Every swing feeds the body, every strike nourishes the soul.
Shield yourself with sweetness, and let your cakes do the rest.
Fortified with nature's blessing, no blade can slice through this crunch.
Bask in the glow of the sun while staying safe from the shadows.
A mystical scepter made with the enchanted essence of easter eggs.
A taste too sweet to resist, a power too dangerous to control.
Enemies who dare face its sweet wrath will quickly learn that the chocolate they once craved is now their undoing.
A robe so sweet, even the fiercest of foes can't help but admire its flavor, without the mess.
Ears of chocolate, ears of charm, ears that make every hop a little sweeter.
Carved from the unblemished minerals deep beneath the realm, this unconventional wakizashi fractures itself when swung to release a strange supernatural energy.
A dagger fashioned from the fang of an enormous spider.
A symbolic seal gifted to the most renowned philosophers of ancient times.
An eerie reminder of what lies in the depths of the Shatters.

A heavily serrated blade set studded with thorns from the many ravenous plants of the Sulfurous Wetlands. The accursed magic used to mutate the native flora has been likewise imbued to these blades, enabling for a unique yet precise slashing technique.
An enormous shield decorated with the crest of Oryx, an infamous symbol of oppression dreaded across the realm.
The sacred writings of Leucoryx and his disciples, compiled as a tribute to Oryx to lend false credence to the teachings of his twisted followers.
A coin pilfered from the endless vault of Gemsbok's hoarded wealth. Only the most daring would stake their lives on the equal odds of a coin flip.

Dammah's powers of summoning portals stem from this profane spell. Most may use it to call attacks from primitive dimensions of untapped energy, but Oryx's greatest thaumaturges can create stable gateways to the realm and beyond.
To dominate the battlefield, Beisa's assault units possess this star model to remain vigorous in combat before controlling zones with its independent throwing arcs.
A magical honeycomb that was once crucial in repelling an assault from the Hornet Rebellion.

Easter celebrations call for eggs, but Oryx's strict regulations on anything that might be a chicken makes eggs risky. This mace mimics the functions of an egg to summon pre-grown rabbits, with exactly the personality you'd expect from an animal raised by a weapon.
This scepter's blast is so powerful it will slow opponents.
This strange weapon was used by ancient battle mages to deter invaders. The secret to its construction has long been lost.
This heavy cloak cleverly conceals its user not by magic, but by channeling the light around them as camouflage. Tampering with this light briefly projects a false mirror image of oneself.

Efforts by lower workers of the kogbolds to arm themselves against invaders has resulted in various interesting crudely made armaments. Fashioned from the boiler of a steam generator, this staff projects its scalding vapors towards a target, cooking them alive.
A mighty mug for a mighty drink! Be merry!\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron
The dolomite stone makes you feel able to stand against anything.
A lavish golden ring adorned with a prized ruby from Dreadstump's spoils.
An arachnid star which slings silk to tangle predators while granting oneself the speed and stamina of Arachna's most agile young.
Deep within the blood, cartilage, and twisted bone lies the cranium of a once-human victim.
Unlocks new items in the Item Forge. Also, one Blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction.
No one would dare question your dominance of the Hunting Grounds while wearing the remains of a decapitated gumball machine.
Unlocks new items in the Item Forge. Also, one Blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction.
This lightwave blade is carefully attuned to madness harmonics in a revolutionary attempt to remotely blast any region with the fury of the F.E.R.A.L.'s energy attack.
Unlocks new items in the Item Forge. Also, one Blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction.
As the heavens decreed, the age of dragons came swiftly to an end. Yet the gaze of the mighty watch intensely over the world, waiting for the power of Draconis to rise once again.
Unlocks new items in the Item Forge. Also, one Blueprint can be dismantled for some Forgefire reduction.
This dagger brings out a scent of spring rain and wild roses.
A delicate masterpiece infused with ancient magic and the essence of spring itself.
Each flower pellet that flies gently softly through the breeze calms even the most ferocious enemy from fighting.
A bouquet of radiant pink magical roses that seem to blush with every glance.
When drawn in combat, petals spiral in the air like a spring storm, and each strike carries a faint trail of floral essence, soothing allies and unnerving foes.

This katana's edge never dulls as long as its flowers continue to bloom. In battle, each strike scatters glowing petals that dance in the air, disorienting foes and leaving behind a trail of serene destruction.
This armor not only offers protection but also a symbolic connection to nature's elegance and resilience.
This robe is adorned with delicate floral patterns and soft, flowing leaves that seem to dance with every movement.
This jacket piece is adorned with intricately carved flowers and delicately trailing leaves which give the hero a layer of magical protection.
This blooming flower ring will bring a touch of grace and charm on your adventures while also keeping you alive and healthy.
The perfect tool for dismembering theatre equipment.
Ruthven hid this blade in the hope none would be able to find it, for it could destroy him and his spawn in a single slash.
This ghastly blade has the power to emit waves of energy that dance like wraiths in the dark.
A well-crafted bow made from the hardened spider exoskeletons and their powerful silk.
Carved from the heartwood of an ancient tree and imbued with the whispering spirits of the forest, this staff channels centuries of wisdom.
Legend has it that this wand was written into existence by a book that wrote itself.
A prickly bow with unshaven thorns jutting out from the grip, making it unwieldy to fire.
A lavish golden ring adorned with a prized ruby from Dreadstump's spoils.
A grand scroll capable of summoning sharpened emerald shards, slicing through even the most durable opponent.
Light armor crafted from the hard-as-steel leafy scales of a Leaf Dragon.

The oldest forms of automatic computing built by the Kogbolds were a far cry from the self improving artificial intelligence of the modern Core designs. Though its computation capabilities are lost to time, the matrix remains conveniently effective at distributing powerful surges of energy.
An extraordinarily dense silversteel anchor attached to a magical kelpwoven chain. Whatever ship it was attached to has long since been dragged to the depths.
Once a gift from the heavens, these flails now bear tarnished grace, echoes of angelic power twisted to bind what even light could not cleanse.
Shaped from substance that defies all logic, these blades seem to exist outside time, each strike a question the realm cannot answer.
A spellblade of flawless craft, once wielded by Elysium's guardians, its edge now hums with echoes of a paradise lost to the Void.
A fading relic of faith, this morningstar once shone for Daevite summoners who dared to defy the Void.
An ancient longbow laced with voidborn essence, it fills the wielder not with hope, but with an unrelenting will to defy oblivion itself.
Forged in the silence between stars, these weapons shimmer with the hues of a dying cosmos. Each strike tears through reality like a rift, leaving behind echoes of forgotten realms.
A short cane adorned with a void crystal, used to poke and prod those whose souls were destined to end in The Void.
Its belly churns like a black hole, pulling in anything nearby with a hunger that defies all laws of nature.
The void cloth absorbs the various bodily fluids that could stain the material.
It smells of nothing, but it looks like death.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Void Doctor Priest Items.
Exceedingly large and challenging to handle, this titanic blade embodies the stoic might of its true owner.
A wand made from a brilliant white cross designed to ward off evil.
A trap imbued with deadly venom from the coral of the Ocean Trench.
The fungus covering this armor has eaten away all the metal. While offering little protection, its restorative powers make this armor unique.
A ring crafted from the faceted eye of an enormous spider.
An unusually crafted lute with an ancient style of construction, meant to produce soothing sounds of deep sleep and keep wrathful gods dormant.

With the stone pickaxe, you can break the stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).

With the iron pickaxe, you can break the iron and stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).

With the emerald pickaxe, you can break the emerald, iron and stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).

With the diamond pickaxe, you can break the diamond, emerald, iron and stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).
This shovel reveals secrets lost under the surface of the realm.
This chisel carves through a wide variety of materials in search of new information about the realm's forgotten past.
A heavy hammer designed for multiple uses, like smashing enemies, breaking through walls, and forging new tools.
A tray to store materials, precious stones, and relics that were found.
An explosive that not only uncovers hidden paths but also deals damage to enemies.
A torch that lights up the depths of the realm, revealing secrets hidden in the darkness.
A fragmented prism that is constantly mending its cracks and refracturing. Pulling pieces apart can create an unstable link between two spaces as the prism tries to become whole again.
A hardy slab of ice wounded with crude markings on its surface. Passionate wedding vows are faintly readable.
A grand looking chest from the Tinkerer's vault. It contains extraordinary items.
An ancient ceremonial robe once worn by the Tlatoani.
The azure stone makes you feel ready for any situation.
A silky case of arrows woven by Mama Megamoth's larvae for use by her woodland warriors.

The Woodland Labyrinth is a lamentable example of mortal meddling in the ways of nature, a harsh reality its occupants are keenly aware of. A sheath like this, fully embracing their own ways of life, is no doubt a bitter expression of dissent.
The frostbitten winds whisper her name, and the blades sing of her sorrow.
As the heavens decreed, the age of dragons came swiftly to an end. Yet the gaze of the mighty watch intensely over the world, waiting for the power of Draconis to rise once again.
Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.
Launch refreshing water balloons! They heal nearby players, damage enemies, and extinguish fires caused by heatwaves...
A solid shovel perfect for sandcastles or smacking enemies in the face! While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.
Dual frozen treats with a sweet bite! Sticky and surprisingly lethal. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

A powerful gun that blasts refreshing water! Perfect for cooling off and fighting enemies. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

Protect yourself from the sun and heat with this umbrella, or use it to defeat some enemies that want to steal your place at the Realm's beach. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

These aren't just for walking on burning sand, they also deliver surprisingly splashy attacks to enemies. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

Long and flexible, this noodle isn't just for the pool, it's perfect for delivering powerful, splashy hits. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.
A bright orange vest designed to keep you afloat in deep water or on the battlefield.
A lightweight, bright outfit perfect for warm weather. It allows great freedom of movement and keeps you cool during intense battles.
A colorful inflatable made for floating, surprisingly useful in battle. Designed for summer rest, but it also offers just enough support to survive intense encounters in the Realm.
A hat that shields you from the blazing sun and heat, perfect for staying cool in the Realm.
A fizzy drink not just for beating the heat, use it to blast enemies with carbonated shots!
A chocolate popsicle not just for beating the heat, wield it in the Realm to deliver frosty pain!
A sour drink not just for refreshment, splash your enemies with citrus power straight from the bottle!
A strange ectoplasmic concoction that can inflict its blight on living and ethereal alike.
A masterpiece of craftsmanship, this full helm was forged in the fires of the volcanic abyss infusing its metal with a regenerative ability.
This armor is donned by the Brutes of the Abyss, focusing narrowly on pure offensive power with little regard to the wellbeing of its wearer.
Stolen from the Queen Bee herself, this scepter possesses the power to destroy evil.
A relic uncovered from the depths of the jungle. It exudes a deep darkness.
A seal made from the Marble Colossus' head. The power of a pure and mighty paladin still remains within.
A historical amulet that has been passed down for generations. Although once cursed in the past, it still holds a hint of its ancient power.
The perfect tool for dismembering theatre equipment.
A weapon used by Skuld's soul collectors to absorb and send souls to their final destinations.
Woven from the shrouds of fallen warlocks and bound with arcane sigils, this robe pulses with ancient power.
Crafted from shadow-infused hide and reinforced with silent steel, this armor grants uncanny agility and resilience to those who strike from the darkness.
Forged in the heart of a cursed forge, this blackened plate bears the scars of countless battles.
A razor-thin blade forged from obsidian and voidsteel, this dagger strikes faster than a shadow's blink. Its edge is in a constant thrist for blood.
Constructed from legendary blackwood and bone, this bow fires arrows that whisper through the air like wailing spirits. It is said each shot carries the wrath of a fallen legionnaire.
This gnarled staff hums with dark energy, its crystal core bound to the souls of ancient battlemages. Spells cast through it erupt with volatile force.
A wand carved from the heartwood of a cursed tree and tipped with an eternal ember.
This massive blade radiates dread with every swing. Enchanted to rend armor and bone alike.
Tempered in cursed flame and etched with forgotten runes, this katana channels the fury of the Legion's eastern assassins. Every slash cleaves both flesh and spirit.
A wand created from the wood of Sprite trees. Seems to be poorly calibrated, though.
A tight fitting garment of snake skin that is both functional and stylish.
A youthful jellyfish taken from the reefs of the ocean realms, residing within a coralglass jar.
A small golden band meant to be worn on one’s ear. This mundane looking accessory appears to give the wearer an increased tolerance to intoxicants.
Jagged obsidian and smooth malachite blades inscribed with runes and teeming with energy. The runes read as a eulogy for those lost while trying to seal a great evil.
Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.
Grants stealth and deadly ambush power, favored by legion rogues.
Harnesses the refined precision of Legion Elite training, launching piercing shots that embody tactical mastery and relentless discipline.
Unleashes powerful dark magic, overwhelming foes with ordered chaos.
A corrupted tome pulsing with dark power, used by the Legion Elite to sustain their twisted forces and prolong their ruthless crusade.
A steel and obsidian helm of grim design, only worn by high commanders of the Shadow Legion.
A fortified shield forged in the abyssal forges of the Shadow Legion, built to withstand the fury of rebellion and enforce the will of their dark empire.
A seal of iron command, forged by the Shadow Legion to impose unwavering discipline and bolster their ranks with oppressive might.
Precision-crafted toxin designed for silent elimination behind enemy lines.
A cursed artifact channeling disciplined death magic to drain and heal.
Strikes with targeted lightning, controlling the battlefield with calculated force.
A deadly projectile of concentrated chi, launched with elite discipline.
A wicked wakizashi forged from shadowsteel, granted to Shadow Legion warlords as a reward for their ruthless conquest.
A darkly ornate sheath, relic of a fallen clan extinguished by the Shadow Legion, preserving deadly secrets of forgotten martial rites.
Mechanized snares designed for strategic area denial and rapid ambush.
Beats of war that rally allies and demoralize the unprepared.
Manipulates reality with disciplined chaos, disrupting the rebellion's formations.
Projects disciplined illusions, confounding enemies with strategic misdirection.
A brutal mace forged from cursed darksteel, imbued with the Shadow Legion's relentless fury and the unyielding force of their shadowed dominion.
An immaculate Nightmatter Core set in a housing that acts as a conduit granting power to its wearer, the power grows even stronger in the presence of additional nightmatter.
A bowl of steamed perfection. Simple yet satisfying, it's rumored to restore energy faster than you can say sushi!
Each dumpling is packed with mystery meat and magic. Who knows what spell you'll cast with a belly full of these!
Circular, chewy, and slightly magical.
Wield it like a sword or devour it like a hero. This crusty loaf has seen more battles than you can chew.
Dark, rich, and full of forbidden coco magic!
Each grain of rice is infused with the essence of the ocean, and every shrimp tells tales of the deep sea. A dish that's truly out of this realm!
Stacked with a patty as mighty as a minotaur and sauces as mysterious as the dark woods, this burger is a feast fit for a champion.
Crafted from the finest greens in the realm!
The evergreen plant fibers woven into this robe pulse with an unusual vibrance. Consecrated in the magic of the forest, this garment lifts your steps and emboldens your mind.
This ghastly blade has the power to emit waves of energy that dance like wraiths in the dark.
This lightwave blade is carefully attuned to madness harmonics in a revolutionary attempt to remotely blast any region with the fury of the F.E.R.A.L.'s energy attack.
An ancient tome covered with fleshy appendages. It contains the secrets to magic often considered blasphemous by priests, used to inflict horrible pain on others.
A fragmented prism that is constantly mending its cracks and refracturing. Pulling pieces apart can create an unstable link between two spaces as the prism tries to become whole again.

Placing this trinket into an appropriate slot found on Steamworks machines activates their overclock drastically increasing output. The increased speed causes a greater amount of wear on the parts of the machine, usage of this item is only authorized to higher ranking Kogbolds.

Forged in silvered fire and etched with sacred sigils, this ring hums with the presence of a vigilant spirit. When called upon, the guardian Komainu emerges to shield its bearer, tempering harm and sharpening strength with the ferocity of a divine protector.
This heavy blade is an unnatural channel for raw, condensed life-force.
Once a ceremonial blade used in rituals to siphon life, this dirk is perpetually vicious to the touch.
A well crafted wand, favored by those who practice ceremonial and blood-based dark magic.
Forged by the Hemomancer's underlings, this katana is a morbid masterpiece of steel and blood magic.
A cursed weapon of evil descent, shooting arrows of solidified blood.
This scepter is an instrument of blatant heresy, twisted and carved from anathematized elderwood.
A shield from a place beyond the gates of war and peace.
This wickedly curved branch was taken from the site of a mass ritual and permanently etched with the blood of its victims.
This crude bundle of ceremonial instruments is held together by a thick crust of dried ichor.
This heavy weapon was once blessed, but has been defiled and repurposed by a cult of fanatics who practice blood sacrifice.
The ultimate prize of a master blood mage, this ring's crimson stone glows faintly with restless energy. It rewrites the rules of the flesh it touches.
The blood of slain foes still remains on this weapon no matter how much you try to clean it off.
Able to reanimate any slain foe still spiteful from their defeat, if one were to accumulating all this enchanted blood then it too will act on its own.
Robes used to subdue and bind any violent foe to reluctantly follow their commands and be controlled.
Worn as a means of punishment for prisoners.
A cursed axe that hungers for blood, it's capable of influencing its user to become more violent.
Despite the bright colorful star on this buckler, when sunlight hits this shield one is able to see it's history of blood and battle scars hidden in plain sight.
Woven together by slain beasts, strong enough to protect its user from cold environments and dangerous threats while keeping the user perfectly warm.
Made for traversing through the cold realms, they provide great comfort while allowing the hero to not lose their footing no matter the terrain.
A much more refined cane than its predecessor, imbued with unwilling spirits that lost their way towards the afterlife.

A specially engineered concoction containing a modified plague virus, allowing the direct infection of a victim's soul. Although it can infect over a massive area, the particular lack of lethality makes it seem incomplete.
Empowering the mystic gem embedded in this armor caused it to violently disintegrate its former shell. Fitted into a new plating, it now massively increases its wielder's capacity for magical energy.
A nearly restored version of a once historical amulet, with the previous gem resocketed into a new metallic frame. It seems to have regained more of its ancient power.
A luminescent vial containing an eerie liquid, extracted through the complete pulverization of a soul.
This ring is not crafted, but a fossilized piece of the great frost mountains the Jotunn call home.

A giant's blade, too heavy and crudely shaped for human hands, yet it moves with terrifying speed when wielded by the truly dedicated. Crafted from pure, hyper condensed glacial ice, its swings leave behind a trail of super cooled air.
Forged from the petrified spine of an Ice Troll and strung with the sinew of a frozen behemoth.
Crude, massive, and overwhelmingly powerful, this great club is the preferred weapon of the true Jotunn enforcers.
Carved from the horn of a fallen Ice Titan and polished by gale-force winds, this staff radiates a palpable, painful cold.
A frozen orb of packed snow that bursts on impact, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
A bow forged from a frozen tempest. Each fired arrow becomes a shard of winter itself.
A staff created from a tree covered in snow. It spreads cold wherever it strikes.
A katana created from eternal frost. It can break through ice with a single hit.
Shaved from the finest frozen ice in the Realm, resembling the soft texture of freshly fallen snow.
A quiver crafted from the remains of a yellow Beehemoth, filled with razor-sharp arrows fashioned from Killer Bee stingers.
A quiver crafted from the remains of a red Beehemoth, filled with razor-sharp arrows fashioned from Killer Bee stingers.
A quiver crafted from the remains of a blue Beehemoth, filled with razor-sharp arrows fashioned from Killer Bee stingers.
A quiver crafted from the remains of a Green Beehemoth, filled with razor-sharp arrows fashioned from Killer Bee stingers.
A ceremonial trap used by the elite members of the Mushroom Tribes to ensnare those who trespass their sacred sanctum.
A ghostly fabric from the other side.
The arrows of this grotesque bow are laced with an inverted energy, causing shots to lose velocity and create brief barriers.
An ornate robe worn by servants of the faith.
Shaping raw magic into spirit-like forms, phantasmal projectiles are launched, each one homing in on the target with the precision of a well trained archer.
The souls of legendary heroes live on in this vibrant elderwood staff. It represents the ancient druidic pact to protect the domains of Fey across the Realm.
A fine sheet of marble charged with the same energy that powers the Marble Colossus. What it lacks in physical durability, it makes up for with a life-breathing aura.

Created to guide the spirits of the desert, this seal has infused itself with their energy over many years. This spiritual energy affects living creatures in unconventional ways compared to normal practices.
This stylish felt cap has found itself at the helm of many tavern brawls, and atop the heads of many poor decision makers.

It is believed that astral stardust landed during the Primal Era, giving life to these now-extinct flowers that adapted to any environment they bloomed from. Consecrated by the infernal spirits of old, these artifacts now serve as a token of friendship with the elementals of the deep earth.
Of all the tools found on Kogbold excavation bots, none is more versatile than the KI225 Chain Cutter. Useful for cutting through unwanted obstructions ranging anything from stone to flesh.
Powerful snow throwing gloves, only the most cold-blooded of hands are able to bear the cold these mittens bring.
Cute snow decorations able to come to your defence and aid you in battle with their dangerously cold artillery.
Able to fend its user in the coldest environment the realm's have to offer.
Knitted with love and care, it's magical properties are able to keep its user warm and protect their heart from turning cold.
Forged in the heart of an eternal blaze, this sacred weapon funnels the fury of ancestral spirits. Each arrow sears both flesh and soul.
This ancient totem pulses with the echoes of long-departed guardians. When summoned, it channels ancestral wrath through blessed flame.
The authentic pa'u sways in rhythm with the spirit realm. Each step of the dance calls forth a memory of long lost story.
A traditional small totem carved from strong and indigenous wood, worn close to the heart. It hums with ancestral chants, protecting the wearer and amplifying the call of the spirits.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Ancestral Shaman Items.

feedable.id: Mace of the Celestial Forest Shiny
feedable.description: Limon's power of nature restoration are infused into this mace for her children to wield, traversing the realm and planting seeds of new life in the wake of wanton destruction.
The magical drop of resin fixed atop this ring is a precious keepsake of the Fey. Those who possess it are protected by an old pact formed by the keepers of the forest.
A well-crafted bow made from the hardened spider exoskeletons and their powerful silk.
This necklace once signified the everlasting bond between two people. As if alive, this necklace carries with it an aura of spite and anguish.
Two of Groundskeeper Gretch's most coveted tools, tainted by a powerful curse that draws out the life essence of its user to maintain their finesse.
Many Rogues have tried to use this to escape their asylum. All have failed.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Spectral Rogue Items.

A crescent of weightless shadow that glimmers like frost on midnight air, the Phantom Sickle cuts through illusions and unravels the echoes clinging to wandering spirits. Its spectral edge parts unseen veils with each sweep, revealing hidden truths that linger just beyond mortal sight.

The Spectre Cloak shrouds the user in a wavering veil of spirit-light that blurs their outline and mutes their presence. While enveloped in this ghostly mantle, they slip through hostile gazes and glide between moments as if half-forgotten by the living world.

The Reaper’s Shroud envelops the user in a cold mantle of deathly stillness that dims their life-essence to a fading whisper. Within this chilling veil, they move with grim purpose as nearby foes feel their strength falter under the weight of an unseen harvest.

The Soul Necklace radiates a faint inner glow as it binds to the wearer’s spirit, heightening their intuition and granting whispers of guidance from lingering echoes of the past. When its power stirs, it steadies the heart and sharpens the senses as if unseen guardians watch from just beyond the veil.
A ring that symbolizes divine might.
An artifact once wielded by a wandering samurai with no master to serve. It was preserved in the Cursed Library for historical purposes, but it remains just as deadly despite its age.
The Tlatoani used this robe to aid them in casting their most powerful magic spells. Like their other ceremonial garbs, it rarely saw much combat application.
The malachite stone makes you feel at peace with the land.
This strange quiver was created in a forgotten age by a lost tribe of Dark Elves.
An uncannily heavy iron ball and chain utilized by Murcian himself, burdened by the weight of countless souls that met their fate at the hands of the warden.
Only until you find true love, will you know what sweet tenderness feels like.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient
Dedicated to the one who will see beauty within.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient
To my better half!\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient
Gloves sewn by a witch and enchanted by a succubus, only the most mentally strong can wield such gloves without becoming love obsessed.
This mask belongs to a cult of love worshippers, they believed that bringing everyone together in sync as one would open up new heights of strength through the power of love.
This soft robe will help calm the mind and relax any hero from stress during battle, it even works on enemies too.
Cultivated from the slain friends and foes lies the very essence of love both the good and bad, any hero who dares to wield such a thing will drive its user mad.
Wielded by those who’s hearts faced difficulties yet continued on, representing both the good and bad and continued strength love can bring.

The first roses to shine in the spring are given the most attention and treatment, thanks to this they’re gifted with magical properties causing them to grow even stronger, many seek out these early blooming roses for their power.
This skull was left behind, infused within the bed of flowers in the floral realms. Now fully bloomed and ready for battle, capable of aiding it’s flower friends.
Weaved together by strong petals, it’s able to hold together tight due to the petals age thanks to Belladonna’s extensive care for flowers.
Beautiful yet dangerous, only those who value the lives of flowers can carry such a rose. This rose retaliates back with sharp thorns to anyone that seeks to harm this rose or its user.
An ancient focus used to channel the raw intensity of a solar flare. It emits a concentrated beam of heat so pure it can slice through steel plates as if they were cooling embers.
A recurve bow carved from the golden feathers of a fledgling phoenix. Its potential for destruction is vast, though it demands the steady focus of a heart in perfect harmony with the sun.
A staff adorned with enchanted petals that never wilt. Once used by the Solar Monarch to command the waves of heat during the Great Bloom, its brilliance has softened into a gentle, rhythmic glow.

Forged from the razor-sharp talon of a Great Phoenix, this blade retains the bird's legendary heat. It strikes with such blistering intensity that it ignores the thickest armor, leaving only ash behind.
A massive, heavy blade forged in the heart of a dying star. It embodies the stoic might of the phoenix's rebirth, though its immense weight and heat tax the physical strength of any who swing it.
Infused with holy solar magic, this sword's edge vibrates with the energy of a thousand dawnings. It is designed to slash with a purifying flame that no worldly shield can hope to withstand.

A pulsating ruby encased in a band of white gold that grows warm when danger nears. It grants the wearer the resilience of the phoenix, allowing their spirit to flicker but never truly go out as long as the sun continues to rise.
A tattered tome possessing the forbidden knowledge of pagan priests of old. It speaks of casting terrible curses upon opponents, but such impure power comes at a cost.
A dagger made of razor-sharp bone.
An undamaged version of a well known archaeological artifact, radiating a potent dark energy. This rare find is coveted by many explorers.
A ring crafted from the dangerous Fire Coral.
This orb of ancient bloodstone has a dark reputation of twisting those who wield it.
This armor does not deflect projectiles like most materials known to man. It absorbs and engulfs them, sending them to a new plane of reality.
A basic pendant used by novice druids.
A pendant with a carved turquoise stone resembling the form of a bunny.
A bronze pendant symbolising the skunk whose form is deceptively powerful to a druid’s foes.
A pendant bearing the form of a fox which is reserved only for more advanced druids. The speed and cunning provided by the transformation is a powerful tool for druids.
A silver pendant representing the wolf, this form is similar to the fox but provides additional strength for combat druids to leverage over their enemies.
A boar shaped pendant, its form radiates strength and tenacity. Druids capable of sustaining this form are among the strongest the druidic orders have to offer.
A golden sigil set with sapphire gemstones, druids call upon the form of the horse for its high strength and unparalleled stamina.

A gilded sigil with ruby gemstones, delicately shaped into the form of the Rhino. This form represents the pinnacle of normal druids, only surpassed by druids choosing to specialize in more mythical creatures.
This necklace is adorned with the tooth of a great white shark. Druids who familiarize themselves with this item may take on its form becoming the apex of the seas.
A live spiderling with a string formed of its own silk, a druid may befriend it to gain increased familiarity with the form of a spider, a traditionally hard form to undertake.
This relic was once used by a secluded cult of dragon worshippers. A druid may tap into its arcane power to embrace the form of a dragon.
Fashioned by the Beekeeper, this pendant allows the wearer to command the forces of the nest directing swarms of bees to attack the wearer's enemies.

An incredibly complex and durable crystalline structure appears on this pendant where a druid might expect the representation of an animal. Familiarising oneself with its forms is incredibly difficult but druids who succeed find themselves to be unbreakable walls against all forms of threat.

This device was forged by an engineer attempting to artificially recreate the ways of the druid. Using it allows for not only summoning robotic raptor companions, but to form a suit of armor that might be piloted to lead them.

Similar to the falconers in the ranks of Chief Beisa, the agents of oryx employed hawks to do their bidding. Their speed and hunting acumen allow them to be incredible inspiration for druids among the agent’s ranks.
A powerful sigil displaying the form of the most menacing creature of the realm. Acts as a flotation device in a pinch.
A pair of horns adorning a nightmatter-weave band. Allows one to mimic the full combat abilities of chief beisa
This pendant radiates warmth that staves off the winter cold, it is adorned with a symbol of a reindeer. Some druids believe the form is capable of flight.
A precision-engineered morning star mimicking a raptor’s strike.
A well fitting electrically resistant suit perfect for operating heavy machinery.
Sturdy brass gauge ring that allows for monitoring its users status while boosting power and protection.

Sweet forest berries baked into a small magical treat.
A hearty root packed with ancient life energy.
A revitalizing brew distilled from the heart of the grove.
A simple forest-grown potato with a touch of moss.
A nourishing blend infused with the strength of the wild.
A dazzling trophy commemorating the winners of Sebchoof's 2026 RotMG Olympics Event.
Legend has it that this wand was written into existence by a book that wrote itself.
A masterpiece of craftsmanship, this full helm was forged in the fires of the volcanic abyss infusing its metal with a regenerative ability.
An angular wakizashi crafted from the core of the Shadow Cube God. In spite of the narrow blade, it can unleash quite a devastating onslaught.
A commanding staff used by vile cult leaders. Its power manifested through countless sacrifices to the demon Molek.
A tattered piece of cloth crudely fashioned into a robe, barely capable of covering its wearer. However, what it lacks in physical durability is made up with a thick barrier of mana.
A bizzare spell fabricated by a powerful bunny magician, they don't only do trick shows inside those magic hats!
A peculiarly weathered rock with runes burned into it from generations of being submerged in the acidic bog. This makeshift snare is unmatched in power, but it activates on its own terms.
Exceptional leather armor crafted from the hardened shell of an ancient, mythical egg-bearing creature.
This sugar-coated focus channels volatile spring energy into a shockingly destructive arcane discharge.
The branch of a great nettle tree whose poisonous razor barbs project under stress to ward off creatures. Channeling magic revitalizes it's thorns as soon as they are fired.
An arboreal cudgel fashioned from the heart of an Elder tree. Mages intune with nature can unleash it's full potential, summoning an entire forest in moments.
A garment carefully woven from delicate leaves. Provides little benefit in combat but supports a much deeper connection to nature for the wearer.
Within this unknown bud lies a hum of Natures energy, if well cared for it may one day bloom into something never before seen.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Spellbound Phytomancer Summoner Items.
A cloak made of a magically contained waterweave, the flowing waters obscure the wearers movement from onlookers.
A quiver filled with Aquamarine tipped arrows that summon the force of the tides on impact.
An unorthodox scroll that calls forth a surge of extreme pressure water slicing clean through foes.
A holy tome whose scriptures call forth the soothing waves of the sea.
A bluesteel helm that grants the wearer strength as immense as the greatest typhoon.
A bluesteel heater shield rimmed with aquamarine gemstone, the wielder is able to strike their enemies with the force of a tsunami.
A seal blessed by oceanic priests allowing the user to beseech the gods of the sea for power.
A brackish concoction of seawater and assortment of piscine venoms, inflicts debilitating pain on those unfortunate enough to taste its sting.
An eternally dripping skull of the drowned, its unholy energies can summon the souls of those who met their fate in the depths.
This scepter channels the power from storms of the high seas, capable of capsizing even the mightiest vessels.
A handheld swirling vortex of water, its strike contains the force of a raging hurricane.
A mastercrafted bluesteel blade, weightless and sharp, cutting through air like surging water.
A delicate yet masterful sheath embodying the secret technique of the wave dash.
This trap is nearly undetectable when deployed on the ocean's surface, releasing a powerful hydraulic blast when triggered.
Ancient merfolk bards would seldom use the lute, instead preferring the gentle resonance of vibrating waves.
A seaglass orb mystics can use to ensnare their targets in an aquatic prison.
This seaglass prism can refract light in changing forms, creating illusions as if they were reflected by the ocean's surface.
This rare and little known mace can call forth a ravenous vortex.
This sacred druid sigil allows the user to take on the form of a great serpent from the darkest depths of the ocean.
The fossilized skull of a kaiju even older and more powerful than the one that roams the Carboniferous.
A heavily plated armor fashioned from the shell of a very vicious barnacle.
A legendary pair of blades capable of tearing holes in the fabric of reality.
A rectangular prism cut to perfection with impossibly accurate 90 degree angles.
Although the Towering Perfection has been toppled, latent potential remains.
A finely crafted instrument capable of producing a heavenly sound from the depths.
A living sigil that empowers the host by merging with their spine.
A cursed book of terrifying legends, myths, and stories from across the realm.
A scepter wielded by the daughter to channel her wrath into rapid, explosive bursts of elemental energy.
A writhing severed appendage capable of channeling dark, eldritch energies.
Guilded weapons befitting one of Oryx's elites. Few could wield such weapons effectively, and even fewer in tandem.
Her success in creating an unbreakable bow came at a terrible cost.
A piece of the Artificial Slop in a state of constant change, never holding the same form for more than a moment.
This armor is donned by the Brutes of the Abyss, focusing narrowly on pure offensive power with little regard to the wellbeing of its wearer.
Captain Davy Jones' ring.
A sound almost like a wind chime emanates softly from this wand.
This massive shield was created for the wealthy and powerful Ogre kings as a sign of their unrivaled strength.
Fashioned by the Beekeeper, this pendant allows the wearer to command the forces of the nest directing swarms of bees to attack the wearer's enemies.
Ruthven hid this blade in the hope none would be able to find it, for it could destroy him and his spawn in a single slash.
An unfathomable amount of strength pulses through this ring. Only the most righteous mortals can touch this ring and live.
A cubic sapphire embedded in a circular gold ring.
This necklace is adorned with the tooth of a great white shark. Druids who familiarize themselves with this item may take on its form becoming the apex of the seas.
Deep within the blood, cartilage, and twisted bone lies the cranium of a once-human victim.

A tightly-woven garment used to restrain the mentally insane in the Penitentiary's torture branch. The echoed laughs of its past users can be faintly heard while wearing it, and intensify as its wearer takes damage.
A blade created within the Hellforge and enchanted with dark magics to grant its wielder the power of a demon king.
An irregular fragment of a fiery comet that once passed over Malogia. Intergalactic legends know it as the herald of the great alien lord Nizos.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient
One of the most unusual feats of Katalonian engineering. This barely tangible sword hurls puffs of toxic gas, if you can manage to firmly grasp it.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
Steeped in the acid rainwater of Forax, the chemical coating has transformed this already mighty blade into a heavy-hitting weapon of war.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
The frigid landscape of Untaris is chilled by the moonlight reflected from a planet of astral frost.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient
The abnormal alignment of Malogia's moons block direct light from its sun during most of its revolution. The brief periods of visibility are ferociously hot.\n\nSprite Credits: Artauris

Interestingly, freezing the acid of Forax into a solid material retains its burning properties. Crafty alien mercenaries have used this to create brutal assassination weapons such as this.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
An accomplished alien conqueror brandished this wand as a show of might, topping it with a gemstone from each planet he overthrew.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
A wand held together by an ice crystal extracted from the depths of Untaris. Each shot possesses the concentrated force of a blizzard.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
Standard issue armor for Commander Calbrik's fleet. It stores energy to power a defensive shield when its wearer needs it most.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
